title: Finite prime chains contract strictly at one filtered-colimit stage
statement: For a small filtered diagram R of commutative rings, every finite strictly increasing chain of prime ideals in colimit R has a stage where all contractions are prime and strictly increasing.

proof.text: Represent finitely many separating elements at stages and use filteredness to find one stage receiving all of them; contractions of prime ideals are prime and the representatives preserve strictness.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_prime_chain_contraction {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → Ideal (colimit R : CommRingCat.{u})), (∀ j, (p j).IsPrime) → StrictMono p → ∃ i : I, (∀ j, (Ideal.comap (colimit.ι R i).hom (p j)).IsPrime) ∧ StrictMono (fun j ↦ Ideal.comap (colimit.ι R i).hom (p j))
